title: Major HIDIVE Isekai Reveals New Look at Season 2 Return After 4 Years
content: Ahead of its long-awaited return to the seasonal anime circuit, Reincarnated as a Sword just dropped a brand-new key visual of the series’ protagonists Fran and Teacher with a stunning updated design and a small sneak peek at what fans can expect when the anime begins airing in October 2026.
author: ComicBook

title: Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain Game's Extended Trailer Reveals PS5, PC Releases
content: Level 5 announced during the Level 5 Vision 2026 II Dream livestream that Yōkai Watch 2: Haunted Domain , a new updated version of the Yōkai Watch 2 Nintendo 3DS game, will launch on PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam in addition to the previously announced Nintendo Switch 2 version.
author: ANN

title: BanG Dream! Releases Yumemita x Our Notes Story Trailer
content: A story link trailer for BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA has been released, announcing that the story of the TV anime will continue in the upcoming game BanG Dream! Our Notes . A band visual was also released. The game also previously released an introduction trailer for the band.
author: Anime Corner

title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village Game Gets Remake
content: Level 5 announced during the Level 5 Vision 2026 livestream on Thursday that its Professor Layton and the Curious Village ( Layton Kyōju to Fushigi na Machi ) game is getting a remake for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Rises Back to #1, Sekiro: No Defeat Opens at #9 in Japan
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, rose from #2 to #1 in its seventh weekend in the Japan box office from Friday to Sunday, and sold 928,000 tickets to earn 1,415,274,600 yen (about US$9.23 million)…
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Screens in U.S., Canada on January 29
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film on January 29, 2027 in the U.S. and Canada. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Movie Hits Theaters Worldwide in January 2027, in North America on January 29
content: Witch on the Holy Night anime movie will begin its worldwide theatrical release in January 2027, with Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment announcing release dates for multiple international markets. It will premiere in Japan on November 20, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Korean Culture Center to Host K-Comics Origin Exhibition in Los Angeles
content: The Korean Culture Center Los Angeles, in collaboration with the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA), will host the 2026 K-Comics Origin Los Angeles – Korean Webtoon Experience Exhibition from September 11 to October 17.
author: ANN

title: Web Novel, Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series The Ordinary Jackpot Debuts on September 10
content: The Ordinary Jackpot , the live-action series based on the web novel and webtoon of the same name, will premiere on the Korean streaming platform TVING on September 10, with its first two episodes released exclusively on the service.
author: ANN

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game Introduces Accessories Included in Expansion Pass DLC Part 2
content: Nintendo introduced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday the additional new features of the paid Expansion Pass DLC part 2 of Pokémon Pokopia , its cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémon franchise . The DLC part 2 includes accessories such as sunglasses, Sylveon ribbon, and bow tie.
author: ANN
